entities.name: Muraganda
entities.description: A primordial plane rich with life and raw magic, inhabited by dinosaurs and oozes, with unstable moons.

entities.name: Saurid Autocracy
entities.description: The mightiest state on Muraganda, a kingdom of saurids and their human subjects in the south.

entities.name: Fang Druids
entities.description: A band-culture of druidic apes and humans in the jungles of the valleys, guarding the Green Hell.

entities.name: Glyphunters
entities.description: Rangers who seek artifacts of the old, lost world.

entities.name: Ley mages
entities.description: Sorcerers who build attunement towers on leyline geysers.

entities.name: Dawnchaser Pilgrims
entities.description: Religious nomads with a Summer City and Winter City.

entities.name: Telu-Set
entities.description: Five human clans who fled their homeland Telu.

entities.name: Wandering Scribes
entities.description: A monastic order of mercenary record-keepers.

entities.name: Galadak's Scar
entities.description: Cold crater field where the first moonfalls hit, lair of Kalakscion and site of the Tarry Spire.

entities.name: Amarth-Tel
entities.description: Occupant of the Tarry Spire, which collapsed after his death.

entities.name: Kalakscion
entities.description: Enormous crocodile whose lair is Galadak's Scar.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders unable to overcome the dinosaurs and oozes.

entities.name: Ghirapur Grand Prix
entities.description: The race whose track runs through Muraganda via an Omenpath from Amonkhet.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: Plane from which a stable Omenpath opened to Muraganda.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: Origin of advance teams deployed to Muraganda.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: A stable passage from Amonkhet to Muraganda.

events.summary: A plane-spanning civilization of Muraganda discovered magic and then collapsed, its moons shattering.
events.quote: The plane's moons shattered to pieces, and debris still falls onto the plane to this day.

events.summary: Muraganda is targeted in the New Phyrexian Invasion, but the Phyrexians cannot overcome the dinosaurs and oozes.
events.quote: The Phyrexians were unable to overcome the dinosaurs and the immortal hunger of the plane's oozes .

events.summary: A stable Omenpath from Amonkhet opens, making Muraganda's wilds part of the Ghirapur Grand Prix.
events.quote: a stable Omenpath from Amonkhet opened up on Muraganda

events.summary: Avishkari advance teams deploy and find the treaties secured with the Saurid Autocracy were not signed with the full knowledge of other inhabitants.
events.quote: Advance teams from Avishkar were deployed to Muraganda a year before the beginning of the race
